description: Find the titled lot (ParcelMap BC parcel) for a BC street address, a PID, the plan in a legal description ("Lot 5, Plan KAP12345", or the old form with its land district, "KDYD, Plan 1234"), or a point. Returns each lot's PID (for parcel_report), plan, mapped area and report page. Only an exact civic address match is one lot; a street, block or point between lots lists the lots around the spot, nearest first, and a plan lists its lots (the open parcel map carries no lot numbers, so pick by plan and size, or on the page).

lat.description: Latitude, with lon, instead of a query.

query.description: Street address with its town ("1234 Main Rd, Horsefly"), a PID ("026-022-109"), or a legal description or its plan number.

name: find_parcel
title: Find a lot in British Columbia
